hints.title: Subtree Sum Aggregation
hints.text: Calculate the sum of node values for every subtree using a post-order depth traversal.

hints.title: Non-Overlapping Disjoint Property
hints.text: Two subtrees are non-overlapping if neither is an ancestor of the other. In a second depth traversal, previously completed subtrees outside the current branch are valid pairing candidates.

hints.title: Prefix Bit Structure Queries
hints.text: Query a bitwise prefix structure with the current subtree sum to extract the maximum bitwise difference pairing. Insert the current subtree sum into the structure only after exiting its branch.

hints.title: Bitwise Prefix Tree Traversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
B: bit length of maximum subtree sum
complexity.notes: Each node sum is queried and inserted into the bit trie in O(B) bit steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all non-overlapping pairs directly takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * B) space for trie nodes and adjacency lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Post-order insertion into bitwise trie guarantees only disjoint subtrees are queried.
